clean_repro.probe: Created collection with vectors:{} (empty config), attempted to insert point with vector data. API correctly returned HTTP 400 with 'Not existing vector name error'
clean_repro.observed: HTTP 400, error: 'Wrong input: Not existing vector name error: '. Collection has no vector config, so vector insert is correctly rejected.

violated_assumptions: Candidate assumes API should reject collection creation with empty vectors config, but PUT /collections with vectors:{} is actually valid for payload-only collections

contract_refs: vectors parameter in PUT /collections is optional object; empty config {} is valid for payload-only collections

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: Points insert → validate vector data → check_vector_names confirms vector config exists → vector_name_not_exists error when config missing
source_grounding.note: 源码确认: insert 操作时通过 check_vector_names 验证 vector name 是否在 collection config 中存在。缺失时返回 vector_name_not_exists 错误。

falsification.probe: Tested with valid vector config: PUT /collections with {"vectors": {"size": 4, "distance": "Cosine"}}, then insert point with vector → HTTP 200 success
falsification.observed: API correctly accepts vectors when config is present, rejects when absent. Validation working as designed.

cognition_match.note: 未命中 by_design 模式。这是 API 设计行为: vectors:{} 允许创建 payload-only 集合，但 insert 时必须验证 vector name 存在性。

verdicts.rationale: 候选声称 collections+{name}+points endpoint 存在参数验证缺陷，允许在无 vector config 的集合中插入带 vector 的点。实测证明: (1) PUT /collections with vectors:{} 是合法操作(用于创建 payload-only 集合); (2) 后续 PUT /points 尝试插入带 vector 的点时，API 正确返回 HTTP 400 'Not existing vector name error'，拒绝操作。源码确认 check_vector_names 函数在 insert 时验证 vector name 是否存在于 collection config 中。候选属于 FP，根因是误读了 API 契约——empty vectors config 不是 bug，而是支持 payload-only 集合的设计特性，且 insert 验证逻辑正确工作。
